samples.question: Inside the violet 7 by 7 mosaic, treat each square's red, green, and blue values as separate grayscale layers. Cyclically slide red one square right and green one square down, wrapping at the edges; leave blue fixed. Mark a registered square dark when its three brightnesses follow red < green < blue, green < blue < red, or blue < red < green. Otherwise mark it light. Which symbol appears: X, plus, T, or L?
